AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Provides functions for managing chat conversations, searching contacts, sending messages, and initiating voice calls. Operational Patterns: - Always call 'searchContacts' first to resolve contact or group names to an 'endpointValue' before calling 'sendMessage', 'fetchSendMessageDetails', 'reviewSendMessage', or 'makeCall'. - Query string passed to 'searchContacts' must not be empty or blank. Constraints: - Message content cannot be empty or blank when calling 'sendMessage', 'fetchSendMessageDetails', or 'reviewSendMessage'. - Calls and messages must use valid endpointValue identifiers returned by 'searchContacts'. - Image attachments are supported in 'sendMessage' via a list of content URIs.
